product: Menveo (Meningococcal [Groups A, C, Y, W-135] Oligosaccharide Diphtheria CRM197 Conjugate Vaccine)

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
N. meningitidis strains A, C, Y,
and W-135 are each cultured and grown on Franz Complete medium and treated with
formaldehyde.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
C. diphtheriae is cultured and grown on CY medium
containing yeast extracts and amino acids.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote: The vaccine contains no preservative or adjuvant.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
Residual formaldehyde per
dose is estimated to be not more than 0.30 mcg.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote: The container closures (synthetic rubber stoppers) are not made with natural rubber latex.

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote:
Do not administer MENVEO to individuals with a severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) to
a previous dose of MENVEO, to any component of this vaccine, or to any other diphtheria
toxoid-containing vaccine.
